capabilities: Open a standalone card-based workbench view of today's goals and current steps
Generate three AI candidate next steps and adopt one by selection
Manage current steps and goal statuses (active, dormant, completed, archived)
View completed-step history with timestamps and clickable inspiration note links
Randomly pick a goal via command or ribbon icon
extras: AI features use any OpenAI-compatible API with configurable Base URL, Model, and Prompt template; the endpoint is auto-completed to /v1/chat/completions.
motivation: Built for people who get distracted easily but still want steady progress, keeping the startup cost as low as possible.
problem: Obsidian has no single focused view for what to do today, what to do next, and what is already done, so easily distracted users lack a low-friction daily progress workflow.

relations.evidence: Please install the Dataview plugin first, otherwise this plugin won't work.

summary: Daily-goal workbench that shows today's goals and current steps in a standalone dashboard, with AI next-step suggestions and progress history.
